items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: when Tony Perani had his band, they were playing at the, at the, at the Greenwald Grill downstairs

ctx.x: And, uh, they didn't, didn't say, well, geez, are you a jazz man or what? Uh, point out what you, what you do? I mean, it's up to the guys, uh, to find out, uh, after, after you play, whatever you do, you know? Yeah. You know, whatever, you thought you could play some jazz? So, so that, that's when, uh, when Tony Perani had his band, they were playing at the, at the, at the Greenwald Grill downstairs, see? Mm-hmm. I don't know what it was, Johnny Bison, uh, Johnny Detroit's band down there first, and, uh, Santo…
Did the, did you have to have a test to get in the Union, in those days?
